notes.title: TRY A 'ROUGH KUTS' DEMO :]
notes.content:
There is a demo now for [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1734470/ROUGH_KUTS_The_Thirsty_Dead/]The Thirsty Dead[/url][/b], and the demo for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1561800/ROUGH_KUTS_Night_of_the_Living_Dead/]Night of the Living Dead[/url] is still popular.

Each [url=https://store.steampowered.com/dlc/1734470/ROUGH_KUTS_The_Thirsty_Dead/]DLC[/url] tends to have a different film flavor, but these demos should give a taste of the casual style of gaming these interactive movies offer.

BTW [u]Merry Xmas[/u] everyone. I hope you're all doing well.
I'm wishing santa gives me more time to make interactive films next year !

notes.title: NEW INTERACTIVE FILM 'SAVAGE WEEKEND'
notes.content:
[b]SAVAGE WEEKEND[/b] (1979)
A weekend trip to work on a boat sounds relaxing.. but not when there's a KILLER stalking around.
These local folk all have their own story to tell, and they might not take kindly to city visitors.
[u]Plenty of choices here to surprise you[/u], with outcomes of potential survivors.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1814390/ROUGH_KUTS_Savage_Weekend/

notes.title: NEW INTERACTIVE FILM 'INVASION OF THE BEE GIRLS'
notes.content:
[b]INVASION OF THE BEE GIRLS[/b] (1973)
You're assigned to help investigate a series of bizarre murders.
All the victims are men who died during acts of passion.
What is the connection to a secret lab ? 
Do you have what it takes to infiltrate the hive of hot bee women ?
Multiple options await you. [u]Try to survive & prove you are the BEES KNEES ![/u]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1791720/

notes.title: NEW INTERACTIVE FILM 'SILENT NIGHT, BLOODY NIGHT'
notes.content:
[b]SILENT NIGHT, BLOODY NIGHT[/b] (1972)
bit early for christmas but didn't want to wait with this one..
pay attention to the story and unravel the mystery of the Butler family..
surprisingly deep plot that may take a few playthroughs to fully explore
[u]who can you trust in this town !?[/u]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1789200/ROUGH_KUTS_Silent_Night_Bloody_Night/

notes.title: NEW INTERACTIVE FILM 'THE DRILLER KILLER'
notes.content:
[b]THE DRILLER KILLER[/b] (1979)
Follow Reno as he slowly loses grip on reality and becomes a psychotic killer on the streets of New York.
He is a struggling but talented artist trying to pay rent while his life falls apart around him, all while a punk band called the ROOSTERS is driving him crazy by rehearsing next door.
His weapon of choice ? [u]A POWER DRILL [/u]!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1781120/ROUGH_KUTS_The_Driller_Killer/

notes.title: NEW INTERACTIVE FILM 'DEVIL TIMES FIVE'
notes.content:
[b]DEVIL TIMES FIVE[/b] (1974)
[list]
[*] Susan loves fire
[*] Moe loves to play
[*] Brian acts like a soldier
[*] David wants to be famous
[*] Hannah is an albino nun in training
[/list]
What do they all have in common ? [u]They are psychotic killers ![/u]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1776670/ROUGH_KUTS_Devil_Times_Five/

notes.title: NEW INTERACTIVE FILM 'MESSIAH OF EVIL'
notes.content:
[b]MESSIAH OF EVIL [/b]1973
Do your best to find the truth behind the mysterious letters from Arletty's father.
Meet the many local folk and eccentrics in this small beach town.
Why do they all seem obsessed with the [b]Blood Moon[/b] ?
The truth is much stranger than you can expect.
[u]This eerie classic is full of surprises.[/u]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1770430/ROUGH_KUTS_Messiah_of_Evil/

notes.title: NEW INTERACTIVE FILM 'GRAVE OF THE VAMPIRE'
notes.content:
[b]Grave of the Vampire[/b] (1972)
The spawn of a vampire and a innocent young woman vows to destroy his father that has committed wrongdoings.
[u] This family matter involves more than just blood ![/u]
This story is a wild ride and you can decide the twists..
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1734730/ROUGH_KUTS_Grave_of_the_Vampire/

notes.title: NEW INTERACTIVE FILM 'THE HOUSE OF THE DEAD'
notes.content:
[b]The House of the Dead[/b] (1978)
Join a strange mortician for even stranger & creepy tales of death!
Multiple ways to navigate each story & multiple outcomes.
[u]Something for everyone in this macabre compilation![/u]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1741540/ROUGH_KUTS_The_House_of_the_Dead/
